correctness.rationale: At the sole wrap index b=n-q-1, the image is the entire interval; every other source J_i maps by unit translation to J_(i+q mod n). The modular permutation has g cycles, one containing forbidden vertex n-1, leaving one renewal path of ell-1 states, while g-1 full cycles remain and are absorbing. This proves block upper triangular form, characteristic factors and pointwise identity on the surviving cycles. Formal determinant identity proves graph zeta; standard Markov entropy/lap inequalities and expanding renewal inverse branches give h_top=log lambda_(ell-1). Finite exact determinants and rational points agree for n<=14, not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: This completes the natural gcd>1 arithmetic boundary missing from a prior coprime calculation: it simultaneously classifies positive-entropy renewal versus zero-entropy identity cycles, identifies g-1 continua of exact least-period-ell points, and shows that a valid symbolic graph zeta cannot be read as a physical Artin–Mazur zeta. These are motivated structural changes, not tiny parameter improvements.
